title: Exact Definitions and Property Matrix of the Five Temporal Evidence Families

Family_A_Count_Based.name: Count-Based Temporal Evidence
parameters: q (sub-threshold activation lower bound, 0 <= q < A_thr)
Family_A_Count_Based.memory_horizon: Infinite (monotonic accumulator without reset) or Epoch W (with periodic reset)
Family_A_Count_Based.computational_complexity: O(1) time per step, O(1) space
Family_A_Count_Based.vulnerable_to_attacker_pacing: Pacing-sensitive if reset/decay is introduced; pacing-robust within tested model if unbounded (at cost of eventual benign overflow)
Family_A_Count_Based.duplicates_existing_mechanism: Duplicates sliding-window count if reset periodically; duplicates simple cumulative counter if unbounded
Family_A_Count_Based.can_distinguish_cycle_a_from_benign: Yes under deterministic rest; challenged under benign noise if q is set below ambient benign scores

Family_B_Exponential_Decay.name: Exponential Decay Recency-Weighted Evidence
Family_B_Exponential_Decay.memory_horizon: Effective memory horizon H = 1 / (1 - rho) steps
Family_B_Exponential_Decay.computational_complexity: O(1) time per step, O(1) space (single float multiply-add)
Family_B_Exponential_Decay.is_concentration_proximity_based: Depends on f(A_t); concentration-weighted if f is non-linear
Family_B_Exponential_Decay.vulnerable_to_attacker_pacing: Pacing-sensitive: an attacker with inter-arrival tau > -ln(threshold/f_atk)/ln(rho) allows Q to decay below detection threshold
Family_B_Exponential_Decay.duplicates_existing_mechanism: REDUNDANT if f(A_t) is linear (mathematically identical to an EWMA of A_t, exactly mirroring E_t with a different decay constant); NON-REDUNDANT only if f(A_t) is non-linear or threshold-restricted
Family_B_Exponential_Decay.can_distinguish_cycle_a_from_benign: Yes, if f(A_atk) > 0 and memory horizon H exceeds the 10-step rest interval

Family_C_Recency_Weighted_Threshold_Offs.name: Recency-Weighted Threshold Offset Proximity Accumulator
parameters: q_low (lower bound of near-threshold band, 0 < q_low < A_thr)
Family_C_Recency_Weighted_Threshold_Offs.update_equation: Q_{t+1} = rho * Q_t + max(0, A_t - q_low) / (A_thr - q_low)
Family_C_Recency_Weighted_Threshold_Offs.memory_horizon: Effective memory horizon H = 1 / (1 - rho) steps
Family_C_Recency_Weighted_Threshold_Offs.computational_complexity: O(1) time per step, O(1) space (single float, bounded [0, 1/(1-rho)])
Family_C_Recency_Weighted_Threshold_Offs.vulnerable_to_attacker_pacing: Pacing-sensitive to arbitrarily sparse attacks, but pacing-robust within tested model for schedules where tau_r < H
Family_C_Recency_Weighted_Threshold_Offs.duplicates_existing_mechanism: NON-REDUNDANT: incorporates a deadband [0, q_low] where benign traffic contributes zero, and normalizes proximity specifically relative to the decision boundary A_thr
Family_C_Recency_Weighted_Threshold_Offs.can_distinguish_cycle_a_from_benign: Yes: Cycle A pulse (A=0.4100) generates f(0.4100) = (0.4100 - q_low)/(0.4554 - q_low) > 0, accumulating across cycles if rho^10 preserves residual evidence

Family_D_Inter_Arrival_Based.name: Inter-Arrival Timing Evidence
state_variables: t_last (integer step of last sub-threshold event)
Family_D_Inter_Arrival_Based.update_equation: Q_{t+1} = rho * Q_t (if no event); Q_{t+1} = 1 / (1 + (t - t_last)) (on event)
Family_D_Inter_Arrival_Based.memory_horizon: Variable, determined by inter-event duration Delta_t
Family_D_Inter_Arrival_Based.computational_complexity: O(1) time per step, O(1) space (two scalar registers: Q_t and t_last)
Family_D_Inter_Arrival_Based.vulnerable_to_attacker_pacing: Pacing-sensitive: highly vulnerable. Any attacker who knows tau_crit can set tau_r > tau_crit, driving Delta_t large and completely suppressing Q_t
Family_D_Inter_Arrival_Based.duplicates_existing_mechanism: NON-REDUNDANT with magnitude EWMA, but duplicates standard point-process inter-arrival statistics
Family_D_Inter_Arrival_Based.can_distinguish_cycle_a_from_benign: Fragile: benign burst traffic naturally exhibits small inter-arrival times, creating false temporal clustering

Family_E_Rate_Based.name: Sliding-Window Event Rate Estimator
state_variables: Window buffer of size W (timestamps or boolean indicators) in exact form; or R_t (scalar rate) in EMA approximation
Family_E_Rate_Based.memory_horizon: Strict finite window of W steps
Family_E_Rate_Based.computational_complexity: Exact: O(W) space and O(1) time with circular buffer; Approximation: O(1) space and O(1) time
Family_E_Rate_Based.vulnerable_to_attacker_pacing: Pacing-sensitive: adversary paces events such that count in window W remains below alarm threshold
Family_E_Rate_Based.duplicates_existing_mechanism: REDUNDANT: exact form is textbook sliding-window detector; EMA approximation is mathematically identical to Family B with binary indicator f(A) = I(A >= q)
Family_E_Rate_Based.can_distinguish_cycle_a_from_benign: Yes, if window W spans multiple cycles and threshold is calibrated above benign rate
